guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Houston this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: Zoo Lights
items.blurb: Themed light areas, animal lanterns and oak trees wrapped in lights. No tickets sold at the gate.
items.blurbEs: Zonas temáticas de luces, faroles de animales y robles cubiertos de luces. No se venden entradas en la puerta.

items.name: City Lights Downtown Holiday Magic
items.blurb: Twelve themed holiday villages across downtown, an ice rink and family activities.
items.blurbEs: Doce pueblos navideños temáticos en el centro, pista de hielo y actividades familiares.

items.name: Galaxy Lights
items.blurb: Space-themed evening light displays and interactive experiences at NASA's visitor center.
items.blurbEs: Luces nocturnas con tema espacial y experiencias interactivas en el centro de visitantes de la NASA.

items.name: Radiant Nature
items.blurb: A lantern festival with large installations, illuminated swings and photo spots.
items.blurbEs: Un festival de faroles con grandes instalaciones, columpios iluminados y lugares para fotos.

items.name: Christmas Village at Bayou Bend
items.blurb: Thousands of lights across a 14-acre estate, with house tours and sensory-friendly nights.
items.blurbEs: Miles de luces en una finca de 14 acres, con visitas a la casa y noches para sensibilidad sensorial.

items.name: Lights in the Heights
items.blurb: A one-night neighborhood tradition of creative home displays on historic streets.
items.blurbEs: Una tradición de una noche con casas decoradas de forma creativa en calles históricas.

items.name: Sugar Land Holiday Lights
items.blurb: Millions of lights at the ballpark, nightly Santa visits through Dec 23, vendors and food.
items.blurbEs: Millones de luces en el estadio, visitas de Santa hasta el 23 de diciembre, vendedores y comida.
